conventions.emphasis: *word* inside a title or line marks the serif-italic $lf-indigo emphasised half (style typography rule: never one family alone); the rest is the neutral sans half.
conventions.estimated: highlightSchedule entries with estimated:true had no ASR word match in basecut-anchors (sparse/empty paragraph); time comes from the scene-map estimate — verify against base-cut audio at build (WhisperX lesson).
conventions.layouts: data-panel = §8 indigo panel/table, rows revealed + spoken row highlighted; twin-tables = mirrored labeled pair, cells land in same screen position; topic-banner = fig12 banner device / type-6 resolving serif title over the running MG; deck-slide & chart-bars = styled reproduction of the printed asset, values character-exact; callout-boxes = designed boxes/chips (fig13, never plain); verdict-table = final verdict act on a table (colour code: green=good, red=worse, gold=neutral).
conventions.fixedSlots: PREPEND disclaimer / OVERLAY brand transition / APPEND endscreen+legal live in scene-map.json fixedSlots — deliberately not duplicated here.
